jobs.prompt: Premium educational anatomical fitness illustration ADULT MALE. Pure white backdrop, realistic detailed neutral GRAYSCALE anatomical contours and proportions, crisp detail soft contact shadows. TWO equal panels broad white gutter, identical adult camera scale clothing equipment across panels. Fully opaque black sleeveless athletic top encloses chest torso sides front BACK; knee-length black shorts fully cover front sides REAR seat crotch, seams folds closed hems, shoes. No transparent clothing or missing backs or muscle cutaways. Red highlights primary target only. Full figures and equipment within frame margins. No text captions numbers arrows logos. Lying BARBELL triceps extension0061. Elevated near SIDE three-quarter camera shows elbow hinge and entire bar. Lie supine along FLAT horizontal bench, head back pelvis supported and feet planted floor. Hold ONE short STRAIGHT barbell with modest symmetric plates, OVERHAND grip hands shoulder width. Left upper arms vertical above chest with elbows extended, bar above shoulders/chest. Right UPPER ARMS remain SAME vertical position, flex BOTH elbows about90degrees so forearms angle back and bar approaches forehead without contact, maintain space above face. Not bench press: do not lower upper arms toward sides of chest. Neutral wrists hands firmly grip bar, no bar through skull or fingers. Red TRICEPS posterior upper arm muscle bellies only, not chest/biceps/shoulders. Same bench feet and equipment.
jobs.inspectionNote: Full clothing and flat bench visible. Lowered bar appears over chest rather than approaching forehead; upper-arm and wrist geometry uncertain, right shoe clipped at master edge. Block movement direction and framing correction.
